evidence.quote: Carrier used AWS Transit Gateway—which connects Amazon VPCs, AWS accounts, and on-premises networks—to connect its VPCs in a hub-and-spoke model. This architecture required static routes for providing connectivity across multiple AWS Regions, which relied on engineers to make manual configuration changes.

Carrier began a large-scale project to rearchitect its global AWS network using AWS Cloud WAN—which provides a central dashboard for making connections between branch offices, data centers, and VPCs, building a global network with a few clicks.
